LanguageData.KCJ_EmptyCityStrategy.label: Empty Fort Strategy
LanguageData.KCJ_EmptyCityStrategy.description: Master the art of "appear weak when you are strong." After studying this strategy, you realize that as long as the monument's outer walls are solidly built — even if the inside is completely empty — you can fool the patron's eyes. From now on, monument quests only require the outer walls to be considered complete (though you must still protect them for the required number of days).
